# AstryxButton { #anylumino.AstryxButton }

```python
AstryxButton(
    label,
    *,
    variant='secondary',
    disabled=False,
    callbacks=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render an Astryx push button.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default       |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| label     | str                                                       | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_    |
| variant   | str                                                       | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `'secondary'` |
| disabled  | bool                                                      | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `False`       |
| callbacks | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks invoked for frontend activations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`        |
| **props   | Any                                                       | JSON-safe Button props. Useful keys: size, type, name, value, form, isLoading, isInterruptible, tooltip, className, and style. Upstream icon and endContent props expect React nodes and are not adapted by the Python bridge. anylumino manages label, variant, disabled state, and click callbacks. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Button>. | `{}`          |
